fields.why: The only weighting is weekly medians 'weighted using the number of weekly reinfections per jurisdiction', which the brief names as arithmetic, not weighting (median weighted by jurisdiction counts).
Same reason: a count-weighted median of jurisdiction medians is excluded from weighting by an explicit v5 rule.

The report names itself a 'descriptive analysis of surveillance data' and an 'ecologic analysis'; 'before/after or trend' is also defensible from the title 'Trends in…' and the comparison across five variant periods.

brief_issues: Whether a title word 'Trends' counts as a named design (before/after or trend) alongside named descriptive/ecologic designs is not settled.
